svg.title: One position drives several frequency clocks
svg.desc: Compare the two coordinate planes of a four-channel rotary prefix. R = 4 and theta = 100 produce frequencies 1 and 0.1 radians per token. Position 1 rotates each unit basis vector by its own frequency; these are not learned vectors.
svg.text: One position drives several frequency clocks
Compare the two coordinate planes of a four-channel rotary prefix.
R = 4; base θ = 100; position p = 1. Both clocks see the same token position.
Periods: 2π ≈ 6.283 tokens and 20π ≈ 62.832 tokens; circles are unit basis orbits.
R = 4 and theta = 100 produce frequencies 1 and 0.1 radians per token.
Position 1 rotates each unit basis vector by its own frequency; these are not learned vectors.
